_comment: Rate cards in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Use this to price a model the
built-in table does not cover, or to replace a list price with the rate you
actually pay. Entries are MERGED over the built-in table, so listing one
model leaves every other model intact.
Note that --pricing is a global flag: it goes BEFORE the subcommand.
Keys match on exact name first, then on longest prefix, so a bare
`claude-opus-5` entry also covers `claude-opus-5-20260401`. A model with no
rate card anywhere is reported as `n/a`, never priced as something else.
The values below are illustrative placeholders, not quotes. Replace them.
cache_write should be your 5-minute cache write rate.
_example_local_model: A self-hosted model costs you nothing per token:
_example_negotiated_rate: An enterprise discount off the public list price:
_example_new_model: A model released after this table was last updated:
